standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of a spectral space as a directed limit of finite sober spaces, with spectral transition maps and hence spectral projections
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3289-3294) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the finite quotients on which the presentation is to be descended.

standard_prerequisites.name: The descent of opens and of maps into a colimit of sheaves along the projections of a directed limit
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3295-3297 and 3316-3319) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the finitely many opens and the finitely many values of the two maps to be brought down to some stage of the limit.

core_obligations: Present the space: the proof writes the spectral space as a directed limit of finite sober spaces with spectral transition maps, so the projections are spectral (proof lines 3289-3294)
Descend the opens: the opens appearing in the presentation of the sheaf are inverse images of opens of some stage of the limit (proof lines 3295-3297)

Descend the two maps: rewriting the two maps defining the sheaf by adjunction as families of maps of finite sets into the sections of a coproduct, and using that the index sets are finite and that pullback along the projections is computed by the colimit, the proof finds maps at some stage which give the original ones after pullback (proof lines 3298-3334)
Conclude: taking that stage as the finite sober space and the coequaliser of the descended maps as the sheaf on it gives the required factorisation (proof lines 3335-3346)
proof_roadmap: 把谱空间写成有限 sober 空间的定向极限 X = lim X_i（跨章引理），转移映射谱故投影 p_i 谱。
把呈现 F 的余等化子中的开集 U_a、V_b 下降到某阶段 X_i（跨章引理），并把两个映射经伴随写成有限集 S_b 到截面的族；由 S_b、B 有限及 pullback 沿投影按 colim 计算（跨章引理），增大 i 后得到 X_i 上的映射 β_i、γ_i。
取 Y = X_i、G 为这两个映射的余等化子，即得 f^{-1}G ≅ F（作者注明细节从略）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a sheaf of sets on a spectral space which is presented by finite data as in the labelled equation is the pullback of a sheaf with finite stalks along a continuous spectral map to a finite sober space (author lemma at source lines 3276-3286, label lemma-constructible-comes-from-finite). The proof (source lines 3288-3347) writes the space as a directed limit of finite sober spaces, descends the finitely many opens and the two finite families of maps defining the presentation to a stage of the limit, and takes the finite sober space of that stage with the coequaliser of the descended maps as the required sheaf (proof lines 3289-3346). The descent of the finite data to a stage is the content; the author closes with the remark that some details are omitted. H3.
